_comment: canonicalVendor registry — source of truth for foundation→vendor graduation candidates (EF-001, EF-011). Seeded from specs/marketplace-audit/ POINT-TO-VENDOR + REDUCE-TO-POINTER verdicts. This is DISTINCT from .claude/presets/*.json recommendedVendorSkills[]: a registry record marks a foundation skill as a graduation candidate; a preset recommendation surfaces a vendor skill for a stack. The two sets overlap but are not identical. Durable workflow skills carry NO record here (absence = permanence signal, EF-001). Records are re-verified by scripts/curation-watch.sh (Slice 3).

recordSchema.foundationSkill: id of the graduatable foundation skill (matches the audit verdict row)
recordSchema.vendorId: canonical replacement vendor skill (repo or repo subpath). A '+'-joined subpath (e.g. coreyhaines31/marketingskills/cro+analytics) is a human notation meaning the foundation skill maps to SEVERAL skills inside one repo — it is NOT a literal filesystem path; resolvers must split on '+' and resolve each against the repo at pinnedRef.
recordSchema.vendorUrl: pointer to the vendor skill repo (never copied — EF-010). For a marketplace plugin the URL may be the marketplace page while pinnedRef resolves against the underlying git repo (see dev-frontend-design).
recordSchema.pinnedRef: immutable reference: release tag or full commit SHA (EF-005)
recordSchema.trustTrack: authority (vendor's own org, low popularity bar) | community (third-party, high bar) — EF-003
recordSchema.trustVerdict: pass | flag | fail — outcome of the trust criterion (scored by scripts/lib/trust-score.sh in Slice 2)
recordSchema.adviceNeutrality: pass | flag — does the skill push proprietary lock-in / away from Claude? (EF-008)
recordSchema.lastVerified: ISO date the pin + signals were last re-verified
recordSchema.sourceAudit: audit pilot the verdict came from (traceability)
recordSchema.flags: optional array of advisory notes (e.g. missing license, REDUCE planned)
